other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must be contributing to the Board's Fund
Applicant must not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for more than one continuous year
Applicant must have met an accident and sustained fracture(s)
Applicant must not be physically fit to resume normal work
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month until the worker becomes physically fit to resume normal work.
documents_required: medical certificate issued by a prescribed doctor
